changelog: Initial EN formal pack: hollow -> structure -> assistant -> lexicon; Wikipedia/blader/no-ai-slop patterns deduped.
v1.1: fix positive_negative_parallel (never matched without a comma before "or"); add en.structure.dash_dense (thresholds are initial and need calibration).

detect.pattern: \b(experts (?:believe|say|agree)|studies (?:show|suggest|indicate)|research (?:shows|suggests)|it is widely (?:believed|known|accepted)|many people believe)\b

rules.rewrite: Name the source, date, or remove the attribution.
rules.reason: The attribution cannot be checked as written.
rules.before: Experts believe this approach works.
rules.after: A 2024 NIST brief found this approach works.

detect.pattern: \b(the future looks bright|the possibilities are endless|only time will tell|the sky['’]s the limit|a brighter tomorrow|transform(?:ing|s)? the way we (?:live|work|think))\b

rules.rewrite: End with a specific result, limit, or next step.
rules.reason: The ending makes a broad claim without evidence or action.
rules.before: The future looks bright.
rules.after: Ship the pilot to three teams next quarter.

detect.pattern: \b(it is (?:clear|obvious|evident) that|needless to say|without a doubt|there is no doubt that)\b

rules.rewrite: State the claim and the evidence; drop the certainty filler.
rules.reason: Certainty language stands in for missing proof.
rules.before: It is clear that adoption will rise.
rules.after: Adoption rose 12% after the pilot.

detect.pattern: \b(everyone knows that|as we all know|in today['’]s (?:fast-paced|ever-changing) world)\b

rules.rewrite: Drop the chorus claim; open with the concrete point.
rules.reason: Appeals to an unnamed consensus instead of a fact.
rules.before: As we all know, speed matters.
rules.after: Speed matters when checkout takes over three seconds.

rules.rewrite: Keep the numbers and names already in the draft; do not replace them with empty summary.
rules.reason: A hollow summary sits next to concrete figures that should stay visible.
rules.before: Revenue hit $4.2M. Experts believe growth is strong.
rules.after: Revenue hit $4.2M, up 18% year over year.

detect.pattern: \b(?:it['’]s|it is|this is|that is|is) not (?:just|only|about)\b[^.!?]{0,120}?\b(?:it['’]s|it is)\b

rules.rewrite: State the main claim directly without the fake contrast.
rules.reason: The 'not just X, it is Y' frame often sounds rehearsed.
rules.before: This technology is not just a tool, it's a pivotal shift.
rules.after: The change cuts review time in half.

detect.pattern: \b((?:here['’]s|here is) what you need to know|the (?:key|bottom line|truth) is this|consider the following)\s*:

rules.rewrite: Delete the empty lead-in; keep the content after the colon.
rules.reason: The phrase announces content instead of delivering it.
rules.before: Here's what you need to know: ship weekly.
rules.after: Ship weekly.

detect.pattern: \b(there are (?:several|many|numerous) (?:benefits|reasons|ways|factors|things)|the (?:benefits|advantages) (?:are|include) (?:numerous|many))\b[^.!?]{0,40}:

rules.rewrite: Remove the empty intro; keep the list items intact.
rules.reason: A throat-clearing sentence adds no information before a list.
rules.before: There are several benefits:
rules.after: (keep the list; drop the intro)

detect.pattern: \b(let['’]s dive in|without further ado|in today['’]s (?:world|landscape|digital (?:age|landscape|world))|at the end of the day)\b

rules.rewrite: Begin with the concrete point.
rules.reason: The opening announces content instead of delivering it.
rules.before: In today's digital landscape, teams ship faster.
rules.after: Teams ship faster when reviews finish same-day.

rules.rewrite: Vary openings and sentence shape; keep the facts.
rules.reason: Neighboring sentences share the same template.
rules.before: It improves speed. It improves quality. It improves trust.
rules.after: It improves speed. Quality follows when reviews shrink. Trust rises when numbers stay visible.

detect.pattern: \b(better|faster|stronger|smarter|simpler),\s+(better|faster|stronger|smarter|simpler),\s+and\s+(better|faster|stronger|smarter|simpler)\b

rules.rewrite: Replace the slogan triad with one measurable claim.
rules.reason: Three vague adjectives read like marketing filler.
rules.before: Better, faster, and stronger results await.
rules.after: Median review time dropped from 4 days to 1.

detect.pattern: \b(in conclusion|to (?:summarize|sum up|conclude)|all in all|in summary)\b[,:]?

rules.rewrite: Delete the stock opener; keep the closing point.
rules.reason: The phrase signals a template ending.
rules.before: In conclusion, ship the smaller release first.
rules.after: Ship the smaller release first.

rules.rewrite: Swap some dashes for a comma, period, colon or parentheses. Keep the ones doing real work.
rules.reason: Frequent em dashes are a common chatbot habit. A few are fine; a steady stream reads as a template.
rules.before: The plan — including the dates — is ready — and approved.
rules.after: The plan, including the dates, is ready and approved.

detect.pattern: \bwhether (?:you['’]re|it['’]s|you are|it is) [^.!?]{3,60}?,? or [^.!?]{3,60}?,\s*(?:this|it|that) (?:is|can be|remains|will be)

rules.rewrite: Pick the relevant case; drop the mirrored fork.
rules.reason: Mirrored whether/or frames often pad a thin claim.
rules.before: Whether you're a beginner or an expert, this is essential.
rules.after: New editors should learn the shortcut first.

detect.pattern: \b(Great question[!.]?|I hope this helps[!.]?|let me know if[^.!?]*|feel free to (?:ask|reach out)[^.!?]*|I['’]d be happy to help[^.!?]*)

rules.rewrite: Delete the aside and address the reader directly.
rules.reason: Leftover assistant phrasing distracts from the document.
rules.before: Great question! Ship weekly.
rules.after: Ship weekly.

detect.pattern: \b(as of my last (?:update|knowledge cutoff)|based on the available sources|information may be incomplete|as an AI(?: language)? model[^.!]*)\b

rules.rewrite: Verify the claim or remove the disclaimer.
rules.reason: This reads like a model limitation rather than document content.
rules.before: As of my last update, the API supports streaming.
rules.after: The API supports streaming as of March 2026.

detect.pattern: \b(let me (?:explain|break (?:this|it) down|walk you through)|here['’]s a (?:quick )?(?:overview|summary) of)\b

rules.rewrite: Drop the scaffolding; start with the content.
rules.reason: Assistant staging language is not part of the document voice.
rules.before: Let me explain: we ship on Fridays.
rules.after: We ship on Fridays.

detect.pattern: \b(in order to|due to the fact that|it is important to note that|it is worth noting that|for all intents and purposes)\b

rules.rewrite: Use the shorter alternative.
rules.reason: The phrase adds length without useful meaning.
rules.before: In order to finish, cut scope.
rules.after: To finish, cut scope.

detect.pattern: \b(delve|tapestry|realm|showcas(?:e|ing)|leverage|myriad|plethora|seamless(?:ly)?|robust|pivotal|foster(?:ing)?|embark|elevate|harness(?:ing)?|underscore(?:s|d|ing)? the importance|landscape|nestled|boasts)\b

rules.rewrite: Replace it with a plain, precise word.
rules.reason: This wording is common in polished but nonspecific drafts.
rules.before: We leverage a robust solution.
rules.after: We use Postgres with read replicas.

detect.pattern: (^|[.!?\n]\s*)(Furthermore|Moreover|Additionally|In addition|Consequently|Hence|Thus|Therefore)\b

rules.rewrite: Delete or replace with a plain connective that fits the logic.
rules.reason: Sentence-initial stock transitions often mark assistant cadence.
rules.before: Furthermore, costs fell.
rules.after: Costs fell.

detect.pattern: \b(could potentially|may possibly|it (?:could|might) be argued that|tends to somewhat)\b

rules.rewrite: Keep one qualifier and state the evidence.
rules.reason: Multiple qualifiers make the claim vague.
rules.before: Teams could potentially rethink their work.
rules.after: Teams may rethink their work after the pilot.

detect.pattern: \b(play(?:s|ed|ing)? a (?:vital|important|key|crucial) role|serves? as a testament to)\b

rules.rewrite: Say what the subject actually does.
rules.reason: The idiom asserts importance without describing the action.
rules.before: Caching plays a vital role in latency.
rules.after: Caching cuts p95 latency by 40%.

detect.pattern: \b(embark(?:s|ed|ing)? on a (?:journey|quest)|unlock(?:s|ed|ing)? the (?:full )?potential|game-?changer)\b

rules.rewrite: Name the concrete change.
rules.reason: Motivational cliches hide the actual mechanism.
rules.before: This unlocks the full potential of the team.
rules.after: This frees two engineers from weekly triage.
